slides.title: Comfort isn't the absence of pain.
Known feels safer
slides.body: Your brain isn't optimizing for happy. It's optimizing for already-mapped. A known bad can feel safer than an unknown good.

slides.title: One small relief at a time
slides.body: Backing out of a conversation. Opening your phone to escape a task. Each relief gets rewarded, and the groove gets deeper.

slides.title: Change feels like falling
slides.body: Breaking the groove feels worse at first. That's not a wrong decision. "A new groove isn't worn in one pass."

slides.title: "Is this peace, or is this just a familiar shape?"
slides.body: Read "The Groove My Mind Wore Into the Floor" at pathways2goodlife.com
